_readme: Maps each of the chamber's 51 Tier B 'Primary Listing Category' values to one of JobsEQ's 20 published 2-digit NAICS sectors. sector=null means no single sector fits -- excluded from the per-sector penetration table, not force-assigned. confidence: 'clean' = unambiguous from the category name; 'clean_nonobvious' = unambiguous once the real NAICS classification is looked up, but not what the category name would suggest; 'judgment_call' = the category's actual member businesses (inspected individually, not guessed from the name) span more than one sector -- assigned to the dominant sector, with the minority composition documented so it isn't silently smoothed over.

Healthcare - Vascular & Interventional.note: Medical specialty, same sector as Health Care & Medical Services.

Non-Profit Organizations.note: 43 members. Nonprofits legitimately span health, arts, education, and social-services sectors; the chamber's category system doesn't record which. Not force-fit to a sector.

Foundations.note: 6 members. Same issue as Non-Profit Organizations -- philanthropic foundations don't have a single NAICS home.

Financial Services.note: Finance and Insurance, same sector as Banking/Insurance.

Insurance.note: Finance and Insurance, same sector as Banking/Financial Services.

Industrial, Manufacturing & Logistics.note: 33 members inspected individually -- large majority are actual manufacturers (Kumho Tire, YKK, Graphic Packaging, First Quality, Irving Consumer Products, etc.), so assigned to Manufacturing (31-33). 5 known exceptions -- Saddle Creek Corporation (3PL/warehousing, properly sector 48), Burgess Pigment / Atlanta Sand & Supply / SCB Minerals (mining/aggregate, properly sector 21), and BrightFarms (hydroponic agriculture, properly sector 11) -- are now resolved individually in data/naics_member_overrides.json rather than folded into Manufacturing.

Veterinary & Pets.note: Veterinary Services (NAICS 5391) is classified under Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services, not Health Care and Social Assistance -- a common misconception.

Information Technology, Solutions & Repa.note: All 12 members inspected are IT services/managed service providers (Computer Systems Design and Related Services, NAICS 5415), which NAICS places under Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services -- not Information (51), despite the category's name.

Marketing & Media.note: 26 members inspected individually -- majority are marketing/advertising/design agencies (properly sector 54, Advertising Services NAICS 5418). The minority (7: three local TV stations, Macon Magazine, Georgia CEO, NotiVisión Georgia, Georgia Trust for Local News) are broadcasters/publishers, properly sector 51 (Information) -- now resolved individually in data/naics_member_overrides.json rather than folded into 54.

Country Clubs & Golf Courses.note: NAICS 7132, same sector as Arts, Entertainment & Attractions.

Real Estate.note: Real Estate and Rental and Leasing.

Apartments.note: Lessors of Residential Buildings, NAICS 5311, same sector as Real Estate.

Lodging & Venues.note: 18 members inspected individually -- overwhelmingly hotels (Marriott, Hilton, Holiday Inn, etc. brands), properly Accommodation and Food Services. The minority (2: The Florrest Awakens, Hollywood Farms) are event venues, properly sector 71 -- now resolved individually in data/naics_member_overrides.json rather than folded into 72.

Utilities & Internet Service Providers.note: 17 members, individually classified in data/naics_member_overrides.json instead of assigned one category-level sector: 7 true utilities (sector 22), 8 telecom/ISPs (sector 51), 1 pipeline company (sector 48), 1 fuel dealer (sector 44). The category itself has no single sector -- it splits almost exactly in half -- but 17 members was few enough to sort by hand rather than exclude. This null/category-level entry is the fallback only if a future member in this category has no override yet.

Professional & Business Services.note: 13 members inspected individually -- majority are consultants and photographers (properly sector 54). Macon Tent Rentals (rental, sector 53) and eco-X.travel (travel agency, sector 56) are now resolved individually in data/naics_member_overrides.json rather than folded into 54.

Automotive.note: 12 members, individually classified in data/naics_member_overrides.json instead of assigned one category-level sector: 5 franchised dealers (sector 44), 3 repair/tire shops (sector 81), 1 towing company (sector 48), 2 wholesale parts/battery distributors (sector 42), and 1 sales-and-rental company (sector 53). No single sector covers a majority of this category. This sector=44/category-level entry is the fallback only if a future member in this category has no override yet.

Self Care & Wellness.note: Personal care services, Other Services (except Public Administration).

Funeral & Burial Services.note: Funeral Homes and Funeral Services, NAICS 8122, Other Services.

Cleaning & Janitorial Services.note: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services.

Waste Management & Document Destruction.note: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediation Services.

Commercial Landscaping.note: Landscaping Services, NAICS 5617, is classified under Administrative and Support Services, not Construction -- not obvious from the category name.

Pest Control & Exterminating Services.note: Exterminating and Pest Control Services, NAICS 5617, same Administrative and Support subsector as Commercial Landscaping.

Staffing & Employment.note: Employment Services, NAICS 5613, Administrative and Support Services.

Security Systems, Surveillance & Monitor.note: Security Systems Services (except Locksmiths), NAICS 561621, is classified under Administrative and Support Services, not Construction, despite involving physical installation work.

Signage, Promotional & Printing Services.note: 8 members inspected individually -- majority are commercial printers and sign manufacturers (Panaprint, Middle Georgia Graphic Resource, Minuteman Press), which NAICS classifies as Manufacturing (Commercial Printing NAICS 3231 / Sign Manufacturing NAICS 339950), not a service sector. Confirmed via web search, not assumed from the category name: The Sign Store Online runs an in-house sheet metal shop and CNC routing for its signs (genuine on-site fabrication, NAICS 339950); Sphinx, Inc. is a commercial printer; Apparel Authority produces its own screen-printed/embroidered apparel and promotional items (NAICS 323113). One member, PAMG, Inc., couldn't be identified with confidence and is left in the majority sector unverified rather than guessed. Assigned to Manufacturing (31).

Retirement & Senior Living.note: Nursing and Residential Care Facilities, same Health Care and Social Assistance sector.

Office Supplies, Furnishings & Equipment.note: 6 members, individually confirmed via web search (not assumed): Active Imaging Services, MBG Office Systems, Advent Business Interiors, Ashley's Business Solutions, Superior Document Solutions, and Office Services Company of Macon are all B2B copier/printer/office-furniture dealers selling and servicing equipment for other businesses, not general-public retail. Conventionally classified as Wholesale Trade under NAICS (423420 Office Equipment Merchant Wholesalers), distinct from consumer retail.

Youth Services.note: Child and Youth Services (NAICS 6241, Individual and Family Services) falls under Health Care and Social Assistance, not Educational Services -- confirmed by inspecting the members (residential youth homes, mentoring programs), not assumed from the category name.

Business & Economic Development.note: 6 members inspected individually -- mostly nonprofit/quasi-governmental economic-development organizations (NewTown Macon, 21st Century Partnership, SCORE Middle Georgia, UGA Small Business Development Center) with no single clean NAICS sector, the same issue as Non-Profit Organizations. Not force-fit.

Commercial Suppliers.note: 2 members -- B2B industrial/safety equipment suppliers, conventionally Wholesale Trade.

Furniture & Interior Design.note: 3 members -- 2 of 3 are interior design services (NAICS 5414, Professional Scientific and Technical Services); 1 is furniture retail (sector 44). Assigned to the majority.

Aerospace.note: 2 members, both confirmed via web search: Collins Manufacturing Company is a clear manufacturer; Logistics & Generation Technology Services, LLC (the name doesn't obviously indicate it) runs an aircraft ground support equipment manufacturing/refurbishment facility in Macon -- genuine manufacturing despite the name. Manufacturing (31).

(blank).note: 2 members with no Primary Listing Category recorded at all.
